message.content:
This is a clamp that holds a bowl to a table. It is made of ABS plastic with internal metal components, and it is used as a feeding accessory for children.

The candidate headings are:
- 3924: tableware, kitchenware, other household articles of plastics. 3924.10 covers tableware and kitchenware, and a bowl clamp used with tableware could arguably fit there.
- 3926.90: other articles of plastics.
- 8205 or 8203: hand tools, clamps, vises. 8205.70 covers vises and clamps, but it is for workshop use, and this item is not a tool.

Heading 3924 covers "tableware, kitchenware, other household articles and hygienic or toilet articles, of plastics." A feeding bowl holder is a household article used at the table, so 3924.10.40 (other tableware and kitchenware) is the best fit. The 10-digit statistical suffix is 3924.10.4000.

CBP rulings on similar items, such as suction-based bowl holders, have gone to 3924.10.40. The metal components are internal and the plastic is the main material, so the plastic classification holds.
